title: Blitz Paintball and Airsoft
specs: Seven paintball fields including a two-story castle
Large 60,000 sq ft airsoft field with over 60 buildings for urban combat
Recognized nationwide as a top regional paintball facility
Minimum age to play paintball is 10 years old
All players must sign a waiver and watch a video safety orientation before playing
Children under 10 may watch in main staging area with parent supervision
Accommodates groups from 20 to 500 participants for parties and corporate events
Private games available for groups; public games also offered
includes: Marker, mask, air/charged battery, and gear pack included in paintball packages
Rental gear and BBs included in airsoft packages
Safety briefing and video orientation required
gap: Exact duration of paintball packages not stated
blurb: Guests play paintball or airsoft on multiple fields including a two-story castle and a large urban airsoft field called Fallujah. Paintball games include public and private options with referees and various game types. The facility offers rental gear, all-day access, and organizes group events like birthday parties and corporate team building.
extraNote: Credit card transactions have a 3.99% service fee · Waivers expire at midnight December 31 each year · Players must watch safety orientation video before filling waiver to save check-in time · Open year-round on weekends
